bound: one SUBSCRIBE packet is frame-size bounded; no per-client subscription count, global subscription count, or trie size quota found
driver: topic filter count, fixed topic cardinality, wildcard trie segment count, and number of long-lived/persistent clients
impact: a default unauthenticated client can retain large subscription indexes by keeping connections open or using persistent sessions. Static evidence is strong; dynamic threshold not measured.
retention: subscriptions live for connection lifetime for clean sessions and survive disconnect when cleanSession=false due persistent-session cleanup branch
scope_notes: Default MQTT protocol path; no admin privileges.
source: MQTT SUBSCRIBE with many distinct fixed topic filters or wildcard filters with many attacker-controlled segments
static_trigger_shape: CONNECT anonymously, optionally cleanSession=false, then send repeated SUBSCRIBE packets with unique filters such as dos/sub/{i} or wildcard trees with many unique segments.
title: Anonymous subscriptions grow global fixed/wildcard topic indexes without per-client quotas
